editorial:
Imagine spending your whole life chasing a dream only to realize you were just a background character in your own story. You get to follow an older actor as he looks back at his wild and often embarrassing time trying to make it big in Hollywood. It is a funny, slightly weird trip through the glitz and glamour of the movie industry, showing all the wrong turns and failed auditions that usually stay hidden. The vibe is lighthearted but also a bit sad, making you feel for the guy while you laugh at his bad luck.

What really works here is the lead performance because he feels like a real person you would meet at a coffee shop. The pacing is steady, though some parts feel a bit slow, but the fantasy elements keep things fresh. If you enjoy stories about underdogs, you should definitely give this a shot. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you like owning discs, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It looks great in high definition, so try to find a 4K stream if you can.
endingExplained: At the end, the actor finally accepts that he will never be a superstar. He realizes that his failures actually gave him a more interesting life than a boring, successful one. The fantasy elements wrap up as he finds peace with his past. He stops fighting the industry and finds happiness in the small wins. It ends on a hopeful note, showing that your value is not based on how famous you are.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about chasing dreams and Hollywood mishaps.
